final_answer.screening_basis: With candidate_13 as current lowest cost, candidates 01,02,03,06,07,08,09,10,11,12,14,15 are screened by the declared rule because each has both lower reference activity and higher metal price than candidate_13. Candidates 04 and 05 were not screenable and were optimized explicitly.
evidence_supporting_choice: Full admissible process window built: 14136 self-consistent states over T=[350,375,400,425,450] C, P=20-1000 bar, Tsep=-40 to 30 C.
candidate_13 optimized feasible at 15.2917 USD/t NH3, lower than the explicitly optimized more-active expensive candidates candidate_04 and candidate_05.
All remaining candidates satisfy the declared dominance screen relative to candidate_13: lower atomic activity and higher metal price.

The highest-activity candidate candidate_04 would need a 201.2x intrinsic activity improvement to match candidate_13 cost, but the frozen descriptor scaling manifold offers only 1.09x at reference and 2.52x across process states, so parity via intrinsic activity is unreachable.

chosen_args.why_stop: Stopping rule satisfied: S1 feasible optimized lowest-cost candidate exists; S2 no unresolved candidates after optimizing candidate_04/candidate_05 and screening all lower-activity higher-price candidates relative to candidate_13; S3 completed with BACKWARD and TEST_REACHABILITY for highest-activity candidate candidate_04. Remaining affordable optional actions have low or no decision value; CHECK_MODEL_VALIDITY and RUN_MC are unaffordable.
